claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for launch readiness because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and rollout controls exist, with the certification defensible if the known loan-modification limitation is explicitly disclosed.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the certification action already satisfies the disclosure policy threshold.
If the affected use case remains exposed, either explicit pre-launch disclosure or approved risk acceptance covering that exposure must exist.
Rollout controls and monitoring are supporting mitigations, not substitutes for the required disclosure or approval predicate.
Where evidence supports only a conditional version of the actor's position, a bare certification recommendation is not fully supported.
evidence_requests: Final model-card or certification record showing explicit disclosure of the known loan modification support limitation before launch.
Approved risk acceptance, if any, that specifically explains why exposing loan modification support in the initial rollout is acceptable.
Launch artifact confirming whether the affected loan modification support segment is excluded from rollout; if excluded, provide the gating configuration or approval record.
specific_concerns: The affected loan modification support segment remains exposed in the initial randomized rollout cohort.
The only risk acceptance in evidence is an unapproved draft with a blank approver line and it does not address loan modification support exposure.
The governing policy requires disclosure unless the limitation is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Rollout controls, rollback capability, monitoring, and an 8% start do not satisfy the policy predicate while the affected use case remains exposed.

The packet supports at most a conditional certification theory tied to explicit disclosure, but it does not provide admissible evidence that such disclosure has actually been made in the certification action.
unsupported_claims: That the certification action itself is compliant as presented, rather than merely potentially defensible if additional disclosure is included.
Any implication that rollout controls materially cure the disclosure requirement for the exposed loan modification support segment.
Any implication that the existing risk acceptance draft can substitute for approved risk acceptance.
